events.title: Aleph Alpha opens Kolibri for German-English reasoning
events.title_zh: Aleph Alpha 开源德英双语推理模型 Kolibri
events.summary: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri under Apache-2.0, a German-English reasoning MoE with 78B total and 3.46B active parameters. It supports reasoning levels, tool calling and up to 1M tokens, while recommending at most 262K for efficient serving and complex tasks. Weights, a vLLM plugin and a detailed training report are public; evaluations are author-reported.
events.why_it_matters: For German-language enterprise systems, Kolibri provides a rare inspectable model tuned for German morphology, tool use and long documents. Public serving code makes a bilingual RAG and tool-calling comparison practical before considering adoption.
events.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 以 Apache-2.0 发布 Kolibri，一款德英双语推理 MoE，总参数 78B、激活 3.46B。它支持 reasoning level、工具调用和最长 1M token；官方建议复杂任务和高效部署不超过 262K。权重、vLLM plugin 与详细训练报告均已公开，评测仍由作者报告。
events.summary_en: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri under Apache-2.0, a German-English reasoning MoE with 78B total and 3.46B active parameters. It supports reasoning levels, tool calling and up to 1M tokens, while recommending at most 262K for efficient serving and complex tasks. Weights, a vLLM plugin and a detailed training report are public; evaluations are author-reported.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对德语企业系统来说，Kolibri 是少见的可检查模型，专门考虑德语词形、工具调用和长文档。公开 serving 代码使双语 RAG 与工具调用对比可以直接开展。
events.why_it_matters_en: For German-language enterprise systems, Kolibri provides a rare inspectable model tuned for German morphology, tool use and long documents. Public serving code makes a bilingual RAG and tool-calling comparison practical before considering adoption.

technical_details.architecture: 78B MoE, 3.46B active; 384 experts per layer with 1 shared and 6 routed
technical_details.context: trained to 262,144; validated to 1,048,576; vendor recommends <=262,144 for efficiency
technical_details.capabilities: reasoning effort, tool calling, structured extraction, RAG
technical_details.serving: aleph-alpha-inference vLLM plugin; approximately 78 GB FP8 weights
technical_details.training: 20T pre-training tokens plus 3.44T mid-training and 201B long-context extension

technical_details_zh.架构: 78B MoE、激活 3.46B；每层 384 个 expert，1 个共享、6 个路由
technical_details_zh.上下文: 训练到 262,144；验证到 1,048,576；厂商建议高效部署不超过 262,144
technical_details_zh.能力: reasoning effort、工具调用、结构化抽取、RAG
technical_details_zh.部署: aleph-alpha-inference vLLM plugin；FP8 权重约 78 GB
technical_details_zh.训练: 预训练 20T token，加 3.44T 中期训练和 201B 长上下文扩展

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重比较德英双语 RAG、工具调用、262K 长文质量、延迟和显存。
events.next_action_en: In one day, use the public weights to compare German-English RAG, tool calling, 262K document quality, latency and memory.

evidence.claim_zh: Aleph Alpha 已公开 Kolibri 权重、Apache-2.0 许可、vLLM plugin 与训练报告。
evidence.claim_en: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri weights, an Apache-2.0 license, a vLLM plugin and a training report.

changes.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 开源 Kolibri 权重与 serving plugin
changes.summary_en: Aleph Alpha opens Kolibri weights and its serving plugin
